01 / The person behind the work

About Raaj Nadar

Stories are my foundation.
Cinema is my language.
Creativity connects it all.

Raaj Nadar is an actor, author, filmmaker, producer and entrepreneur whose work spans performance, writing, filmmaking and creative ventures. Born and raised in Mumbai, he began his journey as a child artist and went on to learn the craft of editing, direction and performance.

His early film experience included apprenticeship in editing and direction across more than 20 films, and assisting filmmaker Prakash Jha on Gangaajal and Apaharan. He later studied filmmaking and method acting in Australia, earning a gold medal in method acting and first-class results in filmmaking. His screen journey also includes work on the Bollywood film Blue.

As an author, he has written novels including JULIET, with an ongoing interest in adapting stories for the screen. His creative interests extend to production, digital content, podcasting and building new media ventures.
